profiles.description: Leads the Human Resources Talent value stream's analytics and workforce-operations backbone at ABC Insurance, owning quantification of supply-versus-demand gaps by critical skill family, current-state span-of-control mapping, and modeling of layer and span cost impacts for organizational design options. The role configures approved org structures and position hierarchies in the HCM, slots roles into leveling bands, and reconciles the job catalog against compensation grades. It also runs the HR cost side of the house: building bottom-up personnel cost budgets by cost center, reconciling actual headcount and labor spend to budget, and adjudicating open requisitions against budget. Succession bench-depth assessment and readiness analysis for critical roles round out a portfolio spanning 32 deliverables including HR policy governance and contingent workforce management.

profiles.description: Individual-lines underwriter working the direct-to-consumer and advised channels at ABC Insurance, owning the processing of inbound D2C applications through to bind. On the life/annuity side of the book the role determines evidence requirements from the age-and-amount grid, requests and ingests attending physician statements and prescription histories, and validates evidence completeness before case assignment. It then applies rating debits and credits per the underwriting manual, assigns the mortality risk class and any table rating, and issues adverse action and rating notices to applicants. Consistent with O*NET's definition of insurance underwriters, this is a risk-selection role that evaluates applications and determines acceptance within delegated authority.

profiles.description: Leads the internal platform capability across the Technology Engineering, Data AI, AIOps, and MLOps value streams at ABC Insurance, provisioning lakehouse workspaces, compute clusters, and storage zones and optimizing platform storage and compute cost against budget. The role authors and publishes technology standards for approved patterns, curates the reusable shared-services and component catalog, and monitors guardrail violations and standards drift across platforms — the 'golden paths plus guardrails' model that platform engineering literature describes. It conducts MLOps deployment-readiness reviews with the platform team, curates reusable patterns into the engineering knowledge base, and participates in data architecture blueprints and ADRs for platform technology choices. Ownership spans API gateway and event-streaming platform operations, cloud landing zone governance, and Kubernetes platform engineering, with an explicit remit to improve developer productivity and delivery consistency.

profiles.description: Runs portfolio governance and delivery visibility across the Program Management Office, Product Delivery, and Technology Engineering value streams at ABC Insurance. The role owns the demand front door — logging new initiative requests in the intake queue, assessing strategic fit against portfolio investment themes, and drafting high-level scope with t-shirt-size estimates — and the investment case behind it, estimating delivery cost, timeline, and resource requirements. It sequences strategic product initiatives and technology investments into multi-year horizon plans and roadmaps against capacity and dependencies, establishes roadmap KPIs with a quarterly review cadence, and runs go/no-go business-readiness reviews. Consistent with PMI-aligned PMO practice, it maintains integrated plans, RAID logs, governance calendars, and executive steering materials while tracking budget variance and benefits realization across 37 deliverables.

profiles.description: Supervisory lead for policy administration operations at ABC Insurance, spanning the Business Operations and Customer Service, Complaints & Experience value streams. The role owns the judgment-heavy servicing work its team escalates: endorsement intake with requestor authorization, resolution of ambiguous or conflicting beneficiary designations, and screening of ownership changes for suitability and anti-fraud red flags. On the retirement and annuity book it owns ERISA participant notices and disclosure packages, plan recordkeeping data compilation for Form 5500 and audit support, annuity good-order review and release to the issue queue, and suitability disposition approval, plus Death Master File escheatment and unclaimed-property remittance. Consistent with first-line operations supervision, it also participates in complaint root-cause corrective-action plans and coordinates process and script changes with operations, owning KPIs, audit items, and control execution for policy administration workflows.

profiles.description: Core policy servicing role at ABC Insurance, owning the full administration lifecycle across 38 deliverables: keying insured risk and coverage data into the policy admin system, generating and assigning policy numbers and account linkage, issuing endorsements and updating in-force records, issuing renewal policies with billing updates, and validating cancellation requests with eligible reason codes. It matches O*NET's insurance policy processing clerk occupation (process new policies, modifications, and records) but with broader owned scope, including life-specific deliverables such as policy loans, term conversions and 1035 exchanges, and grace/lapse/nonforfeiture processing.

profiles.description: Manages ABC Insurance's general-account investment portfolio within the Finance Investments and Investment & Asset Management value streams. The role drafts permitted-asset and issuer-concentration limits for the investment policy statement, runs capital-market-assumption optimization to derive target asset-class weights, quantifies drift against SAA targets, and builds rebalancing trade lists to return the portfolio to target weights. It constructs target portfolios respecting duration and concentration limits, approves buy/sell tickets against pre-trade compliance, and recommends duration-matching trades or hedges to close asset-liability gaps — the liability-driven, guideline-constrained mandate CFA Institute describes as characteristic of insurance portfolio management. The role also compiles the investment performance pack for the Investment Committee and tracks guideline-breach remediation to within-limit cure.

profiles.description: Steers underwriting portfolio performance across the Underwriting, Submission-to-Bind, and Actuarial value streams at ABC Insurance, translating pricing signals into proposed appetite tiers and calibrating referral and authority thresholds to the risk model. The role owns exception governance — quantifying cumulative deviation exposure against appetite limits, compiling deviation reports for portfolio governance review, and escalating over-CUO-authority risks to the underwriting committee — the exception-rate and deviation-monitoring discipline that P&C underwriting-discipline frameworks prescribe. It closes the feedback loop between market results and strategy by analyzing hit-ratio and decline patterns by segment, feeding competitive and pricing insights back to portfolio management, and recording bound exposure into portfolio aggregates. Coordination of multi-risk package quotes, actuarial data-quality corrections, renewal strategy, and delegated-authority performance monitoring round out a 15-deliverable governance remit balancing growth, loss ratio, and exposure quality.

Reflecting its Lead relation to the Risk Compliance Audit value stream, the packet also assigns control-assurance work: logging and triaging identified control deficiencies, tracking remediation and validating closure evidence, reporting QA and testing-quality metrics to leadership, and participating in on-site/desktop coverholder audits of underwriting files. profiles.description: Credentialed pricing specialist leading actuarial work across the Actuarial, Product Delivery, Reinsurance, and Underwriting value streams at ABC Insurance — a multi-line remit spanning life/annuity behavior studies and P&C ratemaking. The role owns lapse, surrender, and policyholder-behavior studies end to end: assembling termination and persistency datasets, calculating experience lapse rates by duration cohort, and modeling dynamic lapse sensitivity to rate and moneyness drivers. On the ratemaking side it assembles and validates loss and exposure data, develops base rates and loss-cost relativities, builds technical premium from rating models, validates rates against filed rates and minimum-premium rules, and assesses target loss ratio and account profitability. It also runs experience and exposure rating on reinsurance treaty layers and builds premium/loss-ratio/profitability projections for business cases — squarely matching O*NET's actuary occupation, which lists Pricing Actuary as a titled specialization ascertaining premium rates and reserves.

profiles.description: Entry-to-mid-level actuarial support role in ABC Insurance's Pricing department, participating in — without owning — the analytical production line behind rate reviews: assembling persistency event datasets, calculating experience lapse and surrender rates by duration cohort, estimating frequency and severity trends, computing trended ultimate loss costs by rating segment, and deriving per-policy and percent-of-premium expense unit rates. The role aggregates earned premium and incurred losses into experience periods, calculates indicated rate changes using the loss ratio method, and documents indication assumptions and sensitivities in actuarial memos. Per its responsibilities it also benchmarks rates against competitor filings by state, maintains rating factor tables and validates rate implementations in the policy admin system, and prepares data calls and exhibits for rate filings — the analyst tier O*NET identifies as the entry point of the actuarial career path.
